original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹扬比奥74名曾与武装团体有关联的儿童完成六个月重返社会培训后毕业
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州扬比奥74名曾与武装团体有关联的儿童完成为期六个月的职业培训与重返社会项目后毕业。该项目由Save Lives Initiative在Tiindoka职业培训中心实施，并获得联合国儿童基金会、联合国南苏丹特派团和州政府支持。培训面向扬比奥、埃佐和坦布拉三县曾被释放的青少年，内容包括职业技能、农业示范和商业管理。报道为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 74名曾与武装团体有关联的儿童完成为期六个月的职业培训与重返社会项目后毕业
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Seventy-four children formerly associated with armed groups have graduated after completing a six-month vocational training and reintegration program in Yambio, Western Equatoria State.

key_facts.fact: 部分毕业生此前曾与SPLA-IO及其他武装团体有关联
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The graduates, some of whom were previously associated with the SPLA-IO and other armed groups

key_facts.fact: 项目由Save Lives Initiative在Tiindoka职业培训中心实施，获联合国儿童基金会、联合国南苏丹特派团和州政府支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: received training through Save Lives Initiative (SLI) at Tiindoka Vocational Training Centre, with support from UNICEF, the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) and the state government

key_facts.fact: 培训对象为扬比奥、埃佐和坦布拉三县经州级儿童保护工作组等努力从武装团体释放的青少年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The programme targeted young people from Yambio, Ezo and Tambura counties who had been released from armed groups

key_facts.fact: 这是第三批完成该职业培训项目的毕业生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the 74 graduates were the third cohort to complete the vocational training program

uncertainties: 报道为单一来源，尚缺乏其他独立来源交叉验证
毕业生人数及项目细节未获其他来源确认
